mapper.sql: article_id, article_label_id, article_author, article_title, article_summary, article_type_id, article_content, article_content_html, article_image, user_id, article_good_num, article_view_num, article_community_id, create_time, recommend, enable, is_delete, is_featured
mapper.select:
select substr(s.org_no,1,${orgLength}) orgNo, s.org_name orgName, count(1) articleNumber from bbs_article t join bbs_user u on t.user_id = u.id join bbs_sa_org s on u.org_no = s.org_no where t.is_delete = 0 and t.enable = 1
and s.org_no like concat(#{orgNo},'%')
and t.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND t.create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
group by substr(s.org_no,1,${orgLength}),s.org_name

SELECT t.orgNo, t.orgName, t.posts, t.replies, t.points, rank() OVER (ORDER BY t.points DESC, t.orgNo) AS rankNum FROM ( SELECT t1.org_no AS orgNo, t1.org_name AS orgName, coalesce(t2.posts, 0) AS posts, coalesce(t3.replies, 0) AS replies, coalesce(t4.featuredPosts, 0) AS featuredPosts, coalesce(t5.logPoints, 0) AS points FROM ( SELECT s.org_no, s.org_name FROM bbs_sa_org s WHERE s.is_delete = 0 AND s.org_no LIKE concat(#{orgNo}, '%') AND s.org_no != #{orgNo} AND length(s.org_no) <= ${orgLength} ) t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) AS org_no, count(1) AS posts FROM bbs_article t JOIN bbs_user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.is_delete = 0 AND t.enable = 1 AND u.org_no LIKE concat(#{orgNo}, '%') AND t.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND t.create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) ) t2 ON t1.org_no = t2.org_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) AS org_no, count(1) AS replies FROM bbs_comment t JOIN bbs_user u ON t.comment_user_id = u.id WHERE t.is_delete = 0 AND t.enable = 1 AND u.org_no LIKE concat(#{orgNo}, '%') AND t.comment_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(t.comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND t.comment_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(t.comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) ) t3 ON t1.org_no = t3.org_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) AS org_no, count(1) AS featuredPosts FROM bbs_article t JOIN bbs_user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.is_delete = 0 AND t.enable = 1 AND t.is_featured = 1 AND u.org_no LIKE concat(#{orgNo}, '%') AND t.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND t.create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) ) t4 ON t1.org_no = t4.org_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) AS org_no, sum(p.points_change) AS logPoints FROM bbs_points_log p JOIN bbs_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE (p.is_reversed IS NULL OR p.is_reversed != 1) AND u.org_no LIKE concat(#{orgNo}, '%') AND p.create_time >= #{startTime} AND p.create_time < CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY substr(u.org_no, 1, ${orgLength}) ) t5 ON t1.org_no = t5.org_no ) t ORDER BY t.points DESC, t.orgNo

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickName, u.portrait AS portrait, u.org_no AS orgNo, o.org_name AS orgName, COALESCE(t2.posts, 0) AS posts, COALESCE(t3.replies, 0) AS replies, COALESCE(t4.logPoints, 0) AS points FROM bbs_user u LEFT JOIN bbs_sa_org o ON u.org_no = o.org_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(1) AS posts FROM bbs_article WHERE is_delete = 0 AND enable = 1 AND create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY user_id ) t2 ON u.id = t2.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT comment_user_id, COUNT(1) AS replies FROM bbs_comment WHERE is_delete = 0 AND enable = 1 AND comment_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND comment_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY comment_user_id ) t3 ON u.id = t3.comment_user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(points_change) AS logPoints FROM bbs_points_log WHERE (is_reversed IS NULL OR is_reversed != 1) AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY user_id ) t4 ON u.id = t4.user_id WHERE u.is_delete = 0 AND COALESCE(t4.logPoints, 0) > 0 ORDER BY points DESC, u.id LIMIT #{size}

SELECT ranked.userId, ranked.nickName, ranked.portrait, ranked.orgNo, ranked.orgName, ranked.posts, ranked.replies, ranked.points, ranked.rankNum FROM ( SELECT u.id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickName, u.portrait AS portrait, u.org_no AS orgNo, o.org_name AS orgName, COALESCE(t2.posts, 0) AS posts, COALESCE(t3.replies, 0) AS replies, COALESCE(t4.logPoints, 0) AS points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t4.logPoints, 0) DESC, u.id) AS rankNum FROM bbs_user u LEFT JOIN bbs_sa_org o ON u.org_no = o.org_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(1) AS posts FROM bbs_article WHERE is_delete = 0 AND enable = 1 AND create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY user_id ) t2 ON u.id = t2.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT comment_user_id, COUNT(1) AS replies FROM bbs_comment WHERE is_delete = 0 AND enable = 1 AND comment_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') to_date(comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND comment_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY to_date(comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY comment_user_id ) t3 ON u.id = t3.comment_user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(points_change) AS logPoints FROM bbs_points_log WHERE (is_reversed IS NULL OR is_reversed != 1) AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY user_id ) t4 ON u.id = t4.user_id WHERE u.is_delete = 0 AND COALESCE(t4.logPoints, 0) > 0 ) ranked WHERE ranked.userId = #{userId}

SELECT a.*, l.label_name AS articleLabelName FROM bbs_article a LEFT JOIN bbs_article_label l ON a.article_label_id = l.label_id WHERE a.is_delete = 0 AND a.enable = 1 AND a.is_featured = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bbs_article a WHERE a.is_delete = 0 AND a.enable = 1 AND a.is_featured = 1
AND a.article_label_id = #{labelId}
